{{Top|leg}}
'''''Olumpa''''' was a civilian [[Container transport]] that was carrying [[Foodstuff/Legends|Foodstuffs]]. The transport was passing through [[Navigation buoy/Legends|Navigation buoys]] [[B-52]] and [[B-53]] for an unknown destination. A single [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] was present at the route and scanned the container transport despite [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fighters running interference.
